worker_output.summary: Implemented full application shell with screen routing and F-key navigation. Key changes: (1) reducer.ts: Added NAVIGATE action handler that validates screen name against ScreenType union and updates both state.currentScreen and state.ui.currentScreen atomically. (2) app.ts: Rewrote as full screen router — creates containers for all 6 screens (galaxy/colonies/fleets/research/diplomacy/design), wires F-key keyboard handlers (F1=MAP, F2=PLANETS, F3=FLEET, F4=TECH, F5=RACES, F6=DESIGN, F10=GAME), binds Enter/Space to NEXT_TURN, subscribes to store and drives show/hide/render on screen transitions. (3) CommandBar.ts: Rebuilt as MOO1-accurate persistent bar with F-key labels under each button, active-screen highlighting, embedded status bar (turn/year/BC/RP), and NEXT TURN button. Buttons dispatch NAVIGATE actions. (4) index.html: Cleaned up — removed inline command-bar/status-bar divs (now generated by App/CommandBar), added #command-bar-wrapper. (5) main.css: Command bar now absolutely positioned at bottom with z-index 100, screens positioned above it, new placeholder-screen styles for stub screens, F-key label styles. (6) 5 stub screens created: ColoniesScreen (F2), FleetsScreen (F3), ResearchScreen (F4), DiplomacyScreen (F5), DesignScreen (F6) — each with show/hide/render interface, placeholder layout, ready for future implementation. All acceptance criteria met: command bar renders persistently, F1-F10 navigation wired, screen switching produces clean transitions. TypeScript compiles clean (0 errors). All 386 existing tests pass.
